fee_notes: Royalty is tiered based on monthly Gross Profit: 22% on first $5,000 GP, decreasing for each additional $5,000 increment, down to 9% on GP above $100,000/month. No separate marketing/ad fund fee disclosed. Tech fee: $120/month for software license including up to 6 POS licenses.
raw_excerpt: Royalties Not more than 22% of the Gross Profit you earn through sales at your Store. The 22% royalty is based on a Gross Profit of $5,000 or less in a particular month. The percentage charged as a royalty rate decreases for each additional $5,000 of Gross Profit in a particular month, down to 9% on all Gross Profit above $100,000 in a calendar month.
